description: This PHP class defines the 'LeaveLeaveEntitlement' entity for an HRM system, including ORM annotations for database mapping, methods for accessing and modifying leave entitlement data, and usage of a decorator trait. It models the relationship between leave and entitlement within the system.

classes.name: LeaveLeaveEntitlement
classes.description: Entity class representing the leave entitlement record, including ORM mappings, properties for leave, entitlement, and length, and methods for property access and modification.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave entitlement record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the record.

methods.name: setLeave
methods.description: Associates a Leave entity with this entitlement.

methods.name: setEntitlement
methods.description: Associates a LeaveEntitlement with this record.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days of leave entitlement.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the number of days of leave entitlement.
